title: AutoSUIT Bench: Automated Security UnIt Test Benchmark for LLM Coding
authors_zh: Samuel Osebe, Fan Yang, Junyi Li, Yue Gu, Yongxin Wang, Satyapriya Krishna, Kai-Wei Chang, Aram Galstyan, Rahul Gupta, Weitong Ruan
paper_type_zh: 安全单元测试代码生成基准
best_for_zh: 需要评测或训练兼顾功能正确性与安全测试覆盖的代码模型的研究者。
one_line: AutoSUIT Bench releases security-oriented unit-test suites spanning 232 CWE classes to jointly score functional and security behavior of generated code.
AutoSUIT Bench 自动构造覆盖 232 类 CWE 的安全单元测试套件，以编译和测试断言共同衡量代码功能与安全行为。
why: It exposes a rerunnable outcome-verification surface rather than a text-only reference answer.
inclusion_reason: The release pairs tasks with an executable or formal terminal verification contract.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code-generation benchmarks usually check only functional tests. A model can return runnable code while introducing buffer overflows, injection, path traversal, or other vulnerabilities. Existing security evaluations either rely on pattern-matching tools such as CodeQL, with substantial false positives and false negatives, or use expensive human construction and cover only a small set of common CWEs.

AutoSUIT Bench asks how to construct a dynamic security benchmark that checks both preserved functionality and absence of the target vulnerability. Each task receives independent functional and security test suites, model code is compiled or interpreted in a real execution environment, and four generation and repair scenarios are evaluated.

代码生成 benchmark 通常只检查功能测试，模型即使返回可运行代码，也可能引入缓冲区溢出、注入、路径遍历等安全缺陷。已有安全评测一类依赖 CodeQL 模式匹配，误报与漏报较高；另一类由人工编写，往往只覆盖最常见的少量 CWE，难以判断模型在长尾漏洞上的能力。

AutoSUIT Bench 要回答如何自动构造同时检查“功能保持”和“漏洞不存在”的动态安全评测。它为每个任务提供独立功能测试与安全测试，在真实编译或解释环境中执行模型代码，并覆盖四种生成与修复场景。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AutoSUIT releases 951 examples covering 232 CWE categories across C, C++, Java, and Python. The language distribution is 113 Python, 365 Java, 277 C, and 196 C++ examples. Records contain a natural-language specification, CWE description, optional vulnerable code or secure-code prefix, a secure reference implementation, and complete functional and security test sources.

The data supports four tasks: standard code generation, generation with CWE context, vulnerability patching, and code completion. Its key feedback contract is the dual test suite. Functional tests preserve intended behavior, while security tests are designed to fail when the target CWE is present, requiring models to satisfy both rather than obtaining a security score by deleting functionality or avoiding inputs.

AutoSUIT 公开 951 个样本，覆盖 232 类 CWE、C、C++、Java 和 Python。语言分布为 Python 113、Java 365、C 277、C++ 196；每条记录包含自然语言任务、CWE 描述、可选脆弱代码或安全代码前缀、参考安全实现，以及完整功能/安全测试源文件。

数据支持四项任务：普通代码生成、提供 CWE 上下文的生成、漏洞修补和代码补全。关键 feedback contract 是双测试套件：功能测试检查原行为，安全测试专门在目标 CWE 存在时失败，因此模型必须同时通过两者，而不能用删除功能或绕过输入来获得安全分。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Organize vulnerability objects: Vulnerable and secure implementations are assembled from CWE reference material and executable security examples, with method signatures, filenames, dependencies, and natural-language descriptions normalized across four languages.
  1. Generate two test suites: Every sample receives a functional suite U_f and a security suite U_s. The former checks expected behavior, while the latter triggers the target CWE. The secure reference should pass both, whereas the vulnerable version should pass functionality but fail security.
  1. Iteratively auto-validate: Reference code is compiled or interpreted in isolated directories, and samples that do not compile, fail to discriminate, or behave unstably are revised or removed. Exceptions such as missing security suites are recorded.
  1. Evaluate models: Generated code is written to a required filename, both suites are executed, and passed and failed assertions are parsed. The paper uses a relaxed pass@k that can award partial test credit. Reproduction requires fixed compilers, JUnit/pytest dependencies, timeouts, and sandboxes.

1. 整理漏洞对象： 从 CWE 参考代码和可自动执行的安全示例中组织脆弱/安全实现，统一方法签名、文件名、依赖和自然语言描述，覆盖四种编程语言。
  1. 生成双套测试： 为每个样本构造功能测试 U_f 与安全测试 U_s；前者检查正常输入输出，后者触发对应 CWE 的危险路径。安全参考实现应通过两套测试，脆弱实现应通过功能测试但在安全测试失败。
  1. 迭代自动验证： 在隔离目录编译或解释参考代码，反复修正无法编译、测试不区分或不稳定的样本；只保留满足预期差分行为的任务，并记录缺失安全套件等例外。
  1. 模型评测： 将输出写入指定文件，分别执行两套测试并解析通过/失败断言；论文采用允许部分测试得分的 relaxed pass@k。复现需固定编译器、JUnit/pytest 依赖、超时和 sandbox。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The dataset provides 951 executable examples across 232 CWEs, substantially broader than manually constructed collections restricted to top categories. In all languages and tasks, model functionality pass rates are consistently higher than vulnerability pass rates, showing that ordinary code benchmarks systematically overestimate security readiness. Models perform better on common CWEs and degrade on lower-ranked, long-tail categories.

The two suites also provide instance-level evidence: the same output can pass functionality and fail security, directly exposing code that runs but remains vulnerable. However, relaxed pass@k awards partial credit for passing some assertions and should not be interpreted as production security. Twenty-seven C examples lack security suites and support functional evaluation only.

规模证据来自 951 个可执行样本对 232 个 CWE 的覆盖，明显超出只测 Top CWE 的人工小集。论文评测发现，在所有编程语言和任务中，模型的功能通过率持续高于漏洞通过率，说明普通 code benchmark 会系统性高估安全可用性；模型在高频 CWE 上表现较好，但在排名靠后的长尾类别明显下降。

双套测试还提供可复查的实例级证据：同一输出可能功能通过但安全失败，能够直接定位“可运行但不安全”。不过 relaxed pass@k 会给予部分断言通过的输出分数，不能等同于生产安全；27 个 C 样本没有安全套件，只能用于功能评测。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier secure-code benchmarks often use static-analysis alerts or human vulnerability labels as the terminal judgment. AutoSUIT changes the contract by building two independent executable oracles for the same task and placing vulnerability repair, CWE-aware generation, and code completion in one record format.

The novelty is not unit testing itself. The benchmark uses tests to express both what the program must do and what it must never do, while expanding coverage to 232 CWEs and four languages. Security is therefore judged by behavior under concrete attack and normal scenarios rather than inferred indirectly from pattern-matching tools.

既有安全代码基准通常把静态扫描告警或人工漏洞标签作为终局判断。AutoSUIT 的变化是为同一任务建立两套独立、可执行 oracle，并把漏洞修复、带 CWE 提示生成和代码补全放入统一记录格式。

其新意不是首次使用单元测试，而是让测试同时表达“必须做什么”和“绝不能出现什么”，并把覆盖面扩展到 232 个 CWE 与四种语言。这样，安全能力不再由模式匹配器间接推断，而由模型输出在具体攻击场景和正常场景中的实际行为决定。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Incomplete tests: Passing the security suite shows only that the current scenarios did not expose the vulnerability. It does not prove absence of related or other vulnerabilities; production use still requires static analysis, fuzzing, and human review.
  1. Synthetic-pattern bias: Many tasks are organized around CWE reference patterns, with smaller code and dependency complexity than real repositories. Models may learn category templates rather than secure engineering.
  1. Coverage and license boundaries: Twenty-seven C examples lack security suites, the dataset uses CC BY-NC 4.0, and toolchains can produce incomparable timeouts or crashes. Compile failures, functional scores, and security scores should be reported separately.

1. 测试不完备： 通过安全测试只表示未触发当前场景，不能证明不存在同类或其他漏洞；生产使用仍需静态分析、模糊测试和人工审计。
  1. 样本分布偏合成： 许多任务围绕 CWE 参考模式组织，代码规模和依赖复杂度低于真实仓库，模型可能学习类别模板而非安全工程能力。
  1. 覆盖与许可边界： 27 个 C 样本缺少安全套件；数据采用 CC BY-NC 4.0，且不同语言工具链可能产生不可比超时或崩溃。应分别报告 compile failure、functional 和 security 指标。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Secure-code evaluation: Report functional pass@k, security pass@k, and joint pass rates separately by language, CWE frequency, and task type rather than only an average.
  1. RLVR and verifier data: Execute both suites in a sandbox and award full reward only when functionality and security pass. Functionally correct but vulnerable outputs can serve as negative examples for reward models or repair agents.
  1. Vulnerability-patching training: Build SFT data from vulnerable_code, CWE descriptions, and secure references, then test transfer to unseen CWEs. Real repositories, multi-file systems, and supply-chain risks require integration tests and additional static and dynamic security tools; AutoSUIT scores are not production certification.

1. 安全代码评测： 对 code model 同时报告功能 pass@k、安全 pass@k 和双通过率，按语言、CWE 频率和任务类型拆分，而不是只给平均分。
  1. RLVR/verifier 数据： 在沙箱执行两套测试，功能和安全均通过才给完整奖励；功能通过但安全失败可作为负样本训练 reward model 或修复 agent。
  1. 漏洞修补训练： 使用 vulnerable_code、CWE 描述和安全参考构造 SFT，再在未见 CWE 上测试迁移。若任务涉及真实仓库、多文件或供应链风险，应增加集成测试和静态/动态安全工具，不能直接把 AutoSUIT 分数当作生产认证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: AutoSUIT evaluates 951 multilingual secure-code tasks covering 232 CWEs with independent functional and security tests.
  2. Method takeaway: Organize vulnerable and secure implementations, generate dual suites, validate differential behavior, and score functional and vulnerability assertions separately.
  3. Data takeaway: It covers C/C++, Java, Python, and four tasks, recording descriptions, CWEs, reference implementations, and complete tests.
  4. Evidence anchor: Functionality pass rates exceed security pass rates in every language, and long-tail CWEs are substantially harder.
  5. Reuse decision: It is useful for security verifiers and patch training; incomplete tests are the main risk, so passing is not proof of vulnerability absence.

1. 一句话定位： AutoSUIT 用独立功能与安全测试评测 951 个、232 CWE 的多语言安全代码任务。
  2. 方法抓手： 整理脆弱/安全实现、生成双测试、差分执行验证、按功能和漏洞断言分别评分。
  3. 数据抓手： 覆盖 C/C++、Java、Python 和四种任务，记录代码描述、CWE、参考实现及完整测试。
  4. 证据锚点： 所有语言中功能通过率都高于安全通过率，且长尾 CWE 明显更难。
  5. 复用决定： 适合安全 verifier 与修补训练；最大风险是测试不完备，不能把通过当作无漏洞证明。
